1-cartoon-infographic.text: In six days, God made everything. He planted a garden in Eden, and gave one warning. A serpent questioned it. Doubt, choice, shame, exile.

2-doodle-storytime.text: Let there be light. Everything was very good. Then a very trustworthy snake said, Ye shall not surely die. Crunch. But the story was not over.

3-flat-vector.text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth. A garden in Eden. One fruit, taken. Then a flaming sword which turned every way.
